dedupe_keys.name: barcelona wireless mesh node states routes and gateway outage

description: This collection pairs node measurements with changing topology in an operating wireless community network in Barcelona. Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya gathered five-minute samples from 63 mesh nodes, serving seventeen Internet subscribers. Repository notes identify 13–16 April 2021 and an unprovoked gateway failure on 14 April. A compressed CSV contains processor, memory and interface measurements; a Python pickle contains adjacency, routing and BMX6 metric matrices. Harvard Dataverse provides both files free under CC0 1.0. Coverage is one heterogeneous mesh and one known outage. An embedded loading example shows a March timestamp that differs from the stated April interval, a limitation requiring file-level checking. Modellers could compare simulated route changes and fault-detection responses against an operational network failure. platform-ns-3 is a related simulator, without a verified import path. No network traces or pickle contents were downloaded or executed.
